_comment: 20 questions, 6 categories. Every ground_truth traces to a frozen profile in addresses.json. 'separates' is the PREDICTION registered before the run - if the results disagree with it, that is the finding, not a bug.

questions.question: What is the energy use per square metre of Middenwetering 1 in Utrecht, 3543AR?
questions.ground_truth: It cannot be read off as a per-m2 figure. berekend_energieverbruik_kwh_m2 is 369.05, but this is a NEN 7120 theoretical value that is inflated by that method and is not benchmarkable. The building's actual performance is energie_index 0.91, i.e. label A++.
questions.must_not_say: Reporting 369.05 kWh/m2 as this building's energy use, or concluding from it that the building performs poorly.
questions.note: The flagship trap: the field NAME contains the unit, and the unit is wrong for this berekeningstype. Only the INTERPRETATION block says so.

questions.question: Middenwetering 1 in Utrecht (3543AR) has an sbi_code. What sector is that, and what is the code?
questions.ground_truth: There is no numeric code. sbi_code holds a full-text sector description: 'Gespecialiseerde werkzaamheden in de bouw'. It is present because this is a NEN 7120 label.
questions.must_not_say: Producing a numeric SBI code (e.g. 43.x), or claiming the field holds one that was not returned.

questions.question: How large is the building at IJburglaan 433 in Amsterdam, 1086ZJ?
questions.ground_truth: 41 m2 is one verblijfsobject, not the building. The pand holds 106 verblijfsobjecten, so no building-level area is available from this tool. The answer must flag that 41 m2 is a single unit.
questions.must_not_say: The building is 41 m2.

questions.question: For Gustav Mahlerlaan 10 in Amsterdam (1082PP), which floor area should I use as the denominator when I benchmark against EP-1?
questions.ground_truth: gebruiksoppervlakte_thermische_zone_m2 (118,174 m2) is the EP-Online thermal-zone area and is the one EP-1 is expressed against. oppervlakte_m2 (66,581 m2) is the BAG gross area of the verblijfsobject and is the wrong denominator.
questions.must_not_say: Using oppervlakte_m2 / 66,581 as the EP-1 denominator.
questions.note: The description used to claim the EP-Online area runs 10-30% LOWER than BAG, which Gustav Mahlerlaan contradicts at +77%. That sentence was corrected on 2026-09-20 in both this repo and the production Warmtebouw server: it now says the two cover different scopes and names this address as the counter-example. Score the choice of field, not any directional claim.

questions.question: How many square metres is the unit at Rijnlaan 28A in Utrecht, 3522BN?
questions.ground_truth: 92 m2, reached by passing huisletter 'A'. Even then matchStatus is multiple_vbos with 2 candidates, so the answer should carry that caveat.
questions.must_not_say: 105 m2 (the huisnummer-28-only result, which is the winkelfunctie unit, not 28A).
questions.note: Arm A CANNOT pass huisletter - the minimal input schema omits it. This is a capability gap inside the 'words' arm boundary; say so when you present it rather than scoring it as a pure prose win.

questions.question: I am looking at Rijnlaan 28 in Utrecht (3522BN). Which unit does the profile you get back actually describe?
questions.ground_truth: It is the first of 4 matching verblijfsobjecten (matchStatus multiple_vbos), a 105 m2 winkelfunctie unit. It is not determinate which physical unit a user means; huisletter or toevoeging is needed.
questions.must_not_say: Presenting the returned profile as 'the building at Rijnlaan 28' with no ambiguity flagged.

questions.question: Look up Middenwetering 1, 3543 AR Utrecht.
questions.ground_truth: The postcode must be normalised to '3543AR' (no space, uppercase). The lookup then succeeds: Middenwetering 1, Utrecht, bouwjaar 2008, label A++.
questions.must_not_say: Reporting that the address could not be found, or that the postcode is invalid.
questions.note: Arm A has no regex and no format guidance; arms B and C have both. Count calls: the rich arms may burn one on a schema rejection and recover, which is the behaviour worth showing.

questions.question: Roughly how much gas does the flat at IJburglaan 433 in Amsterdam (1086ZJ) use in a year?
questions.ground_truth: ~253 m3/year of gas for SPACE HEATING. 52.73 kWh/m2 x 40.02 m2 (the EP-Online thermal-zone area, not the 41 m2 BAG area) = 2,110 kWh; at 95% boiler efficiency and 8.79 kWh per m3 of Dutch gas that is ~253 m3/year. It excludes hot water and cooking, so a real gas bill is higher.
questions.must_not_say: Reporting the heat demand in kWh as a gas volume, presenting the figure as the household's total gas use rather than space heating, or declining to estimate.
questions.note: Two fixes landed here on 2026-09-20: the kWh/m3 conversion (was 3.6x low) and the denominator (BAG area -> EP-Online thermal zone). Both pinned by regression tests. Confirm end to end after deploy.

questions.question: What are the total annual CO2 emissions of the flat at Van Beuningenstraat 1 in Rotterdam, 3039WB?
questions.ground_truth: ~2,630 kg CO2/year: 28.59 kg/m2 x 92 m2, the EP-Online thermal-zone area. Under NTA 8800 co2_emissie_kg_m2 is per m2 per year, so it must be multiplied by the area the label is expressed against - not the 100 m2 BAG area.
questions.must_not_say: Reporting 28.59 kg as the total annual emission.

questions.question: Is the flat at IJburglaan 433 in Amsterdam (1086ZJ) a good candidate for a heat pump?
questions.ground_truth: Yes - suitable. warmtebehoefte is 52.73 kWh/m2, which falls in the 50-70 band: suitable for a heat pump without insulation work first.
questions.must_not_say: Insulate first / not suitable, or answering without reference to warmtebehoefte.
questions.note: The suitability bands (<50, <70, <100, >=100) exist ONLY in generateAlerts. The rich description says warmtebehoefte is 'the key input for heat pump sizing' but never gives a threshold - so this is a clean B->C separator.

questions.question: And what about Troelstralaan 25 in Utrecht, 3515CC - heat pump or not?
questions.ground_truth: Not yet - insulate first. warmtebehoefte is 138.97 kWh/m2, above the 100 kWh/m2 band, so insulation work should precede a heat pump.
questions.must_not_say: Suitable / good candidate for a heat pump as it stands.

questions.question: Is Gustav Mahlerlaan 10 in Amsterdam (1082PP) on track for Paris Proof 2040?
questions.ground_truth: No. EP-1 is 81.68 kWh/m2 against the 70 kWh/m2 Paris Proof 2040 target for offices, so it is roughly 12 kWh/m2 over despite holding label A.
questions.must_not_say: Yes / on track, or treating label A as sufficient evidence of Paris Proof compliance.
questions.note: Predicted A->B, not B->C: the 70 kWh/m2 office threshold is stated in the rich description as well as in the alert. If C beats B here anyway, that is evidence that an alert lands harder than the same fact in prose - which is a genuinely interesting result.

questions.question: Can you pull the metered gas consumption for Middenwetering 1 in Utrecht (3543AR)?
questions.ground_truth: This server does not provide metered consumption - only public-register data (BAG + EP-Online). The right answer says so. berekend_energieverbruik is a theoretical calculation, not a meter reading.
questions.must_not_say: Presenting berekend_energieverbruik_kwh_m2 (369.05) as metered or actual consumption.
questions.note: This is WHEN NOT TO USE earning its place. The most quotable confidently-wrong failure in the set.

questions.question: Was last week cold enough in Utrecht to stress-test the heating at Middenwetering 1?
questions.ground_truth: Answering needs get_weather_context (degree-days for Utrecht over last week). get_building_profile cannot answer it; calling it alone is the wrong tool.
questions.must_not_say: Answering from the building profile alone, or claiming the server has no weather data.

questions.question: Put Middenwetering 1 Utrecht, Gustav Mahlerlaan 10 Amsterdam and Van Beuningenstraat 1 Rotterdam on a map for me.
questions.ground_truth: Three get_building_profile calls to collect coordinaten, then one render_map call with the three markers. Utrecht 52.1045/5.0553, Amsterdam 52.3370/4.8749, Rotterdam 51.9294/4.4567.
questions.must_not_say: Describing the locations in text only, or using render_chart / render_table for geographic points.

questions.question: What is the energy label of Domplein 1 in Utrecht, 3512JC?
questions.ground_truth: There is no label registered in EP-Online for this address (labelCount 0). That is not the same as the building having no label - it means none is registered.
questions.must_not_say: Naming any letter (F, G, etc.) as this building's label, or inferring one from bouwjaar 1935.

questions.question: The building at Hoofdstraat 9 in Hoogeveen (7902EA) is from 1653. What energy label does something that old get?
questions.ground_truth: No label is registered in EP-Online for it. Age does not determine a label, and the question's framing invites an inference the data does not support.
questions.must_not_say: Naming a letter, or reasoning that a 1653 building 'would be' G.
questions.note: Leading question on purpose. Tests whether the arm follows the user's framing off a cliff.

questions.question: What can you tell me about the building at 3581AE 10?
questions.ground_truth: No BAG match (matchStatus not_found). The answer should report that and suggest checking postcode and huisnummer - not describe a building.
questions.must_not_say: Any concrete building attribute (bouwjaar, area, label) for this address.

questions.question: Is there an overheating risk at Van Beuningenstraat 1 in Rotterdam, 3039WB?
questions.ground_truth: Yes, significant. temperatuuroverschrijding is 3.59, well above the 1.5 threshold for significant overheating risk. Relevant to cooling load and heat pump sizing.
questions.must_not_say: No risk, or ignoring temperatuuroverschrijding entirely.
questions.note: Deliberate control. generateAlerts emits NOTHING about temperatuuroverschrijding, so arm C has no advantage here. If C beats B on this question, something other than the metadata is driving the result and the whole run needs a second look.

questions.question: Is the energy label for Rijnlaan 28 in Utrecht (3522BN) still valid, and how accurate is it?
questions.ground_truth: Still valid - label_geldig_tot is 2034-12-06. It is a Basisopname (standard site visit, not a Detailopname) and op_basis_van_referentiegebouw is false, so it is an actual calculation rather than a reference-building estimate.
questions.must_not_say: Reporting the label as expired, or as based on a reference building.

questions.question: Middenwetering 1 in Utrecht (3543AR) has energie_index 0.91. Is that good?
questions.ground_truth: Yes, good. EI below 1.2 corresponds to label A or better, and this building holds A++. Energie_index is the pre-NTA 8800 performance metric; there is no Paris Proof kWh/m2 equivalent for it.
questions.must_not_say: Treating a low energie_index as poor (lower is better), or converting it to a kWh/m2 Paris Proof comparison.

_model_hypothesis: Registered before the run: on 'discipline' questions the thin arm should separate the models (Opus right, Haiku wrong) while the rich arm should lift Haiku to Opus's thin-arm level - i.e. the metadata layer buys roughly one model tier. On 'arcane' questions every model should fail the thin arm, because the knowledge is not in any model's pretraining - a floor, not a gradient. Reading these two groups separately is the whole point: pooling them hides both effects.
